result.summary: Several layout and content issues: category chips and restaurant cards are clipped, a restaurant name is truncated, and delivery-time text overlaps on a popular listing.

issues.description: The last category chip ('Healthy') is cut off at the right edge, and there is no visible cue that more categories can be scrolled.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding and a fade/peek of the next chip so users can tell the row is scrollable.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' card is clipped on the right, so the restaurant image and name are incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Inset the carousel or show a partial next card so the last visible item is not cut off.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated without ellipsis or wrap, hiding the full name.
issues.suggestion: Allow two-line wrapping or add an ellipsis so the name remains readable.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, '25-30' overlaps 'delivery', making the delivery time unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Give the time and 'delivery' labels enough spacing or stack them so they do not collide.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promo card is cut off by the tab bar, so the offer is only partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding so cards sit fully above the navigation bar.

issues.description: The last category pill is flush against the screen edge, which looks unfinished compared with the left padding.
issues.suggestion: Match left and right insets on the filter row.
